{"code": "# Final, minimal run: compute only the necessary values and print them explicitly

# Deduplicate and filter
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Correct assay_batch B values
df_clean['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_clean['biomarker_final']
df_clean.loc[df_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute response rates by arm in the cleaned dataset
response_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
response_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute the treatment effect (difference in proportions)
treatment_effect = response_treatment - response_control

# Print only the values we need
print(f'response_treatment = {response_treatment}')
print(f'response_control = {response_control}')
print(f'treatment_effect = {treatment_effect}')"}
function.name: run_python
